queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__gp_location_descriptions ( location_id int(11) NOT NULL, lang_code char(2) NOT NULL, seo_name varchar(100) NOT NULL, location varchar(100) NOT NULL, location_form_1 varchar(100) NOT NULL, location_form_2 varchar(100) NOT NULL, location_form_3 varchar(100) NOT NULL, location_form_4 varchar(100) NOT NULL, location_form_5 varchar(100) NOT NULL, location_form_6 varchar(100) NOT NULL, location_form_7 varchar(100) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (location_id,lang_code), KEY seo_name (seo_name) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__gp_locations ( location_id bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, company_id int(11) NOT NULL, status char(1) NOT NULL, seo_name varchar(100) NOT NULL, link_type char(1) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (location_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__gp_object_location_settings ( object_id int(11) NOT NULL, object_type varchar(25) NOT NULL, location_id int(11) NOT NULL, template_id int(11) NOT NULL, enable char(1) DEFAULT 'N', is_noindex char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', canonical_id int(11) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (object_id,object_type,location_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__gp_template_descriptions ( template_id int(11) NOT NULL, lang_code char(2) NOT NULL, template_name varchar(50) NOT NULL, name varchar(255) NOT NULL, description text NOT NULL, title varchar(255) NOT NULL, meta_description varchar(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (template_id,lang_code) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__gp_templates ( template_id bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, object_id int(11) DEFAULT NULL, object_type char(1) DEFAULT NULL, company_id int(11) NOT NULL, is_global char(1) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (template_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8
